gloss: restart (of a plant or reactor); resumption of operation

definitions.gloss: restart of operation (of a plant, reactor, or facility)
definitions.explanation: Restarting a facility that had been shut down, so that it resumes operating. Frequently used of nuclear reactors and factories, and prominent in news about energy policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再稼働|さいかどう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{再稼働|さいかどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わり、⟦{発電所|はつでんしょ}→発電所：15991_hatsudensho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{再稼働|さいかどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: After the safety inspection ended, it was decided to restart the power plant.

notes:
Refers to restarting a facility — especially a nuclear reactor or power plant — that had been stopped. A common term in reporting on energy and safety policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再稼働|さいかどう}: restart of a nuclear plant
- {再稼働|さいかどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to approve a restart
- {再稼働|さいかどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to oppose a restart
